title: How to Identify Your AirPods Generation
excerpt: Because AirPods look very similar, you need to check the model number to figure out which generation you own.
body_html:
Apple's wireless earbuds often look identical across different releases, making it challenging to tell them apart visually. To figure out which generation you own, you must locate the specific model number.

Where to Find the Model Number

The model number can be found in a few different locations:

  • In the device settings on a connected Apple device
  • Printed directly on the AirPods themselves
  • Located on the charging case

Once you locate the model number, you can match it against official identification guides to determine the exact generation of your device.
